dynamic.avg_monthly_credit_amount: Average amount of money added to the account each month
dynamic.avg_monthly_withdrawal_amount: Average amount of money taken out from the account each month
dynamic.avg_monthly_net_flow: Average difference between money coming in and going out each month
dynamic.monthly_net_flow_variance: Variation in monthly net flow over time
dynamic.monthly_withdrawal_amount_variance: Variation in monthly withdrawal amounts across months
dynamic.monthly_credit_amount_variance: Variation in monthly credit amounts across months
dynamic.avg_monthly_credit_count: Average number of money-in transactions per month
dynamic.avg_monthly_withdrawal_count: Average number of money-out transactions per month
dynamic.monthly_withdrawal_count_variance: Variation in the count of monthly withdrawal transactions
dynamic.monthly_credit_count_variance: Variation in the count of monthly credit transactions
dynamic.monthly_atm_txn_count: Average number of ATM transactions per month
dynamic.monthly_web_txn_count: Average number of online or web-based transactions per month
dynamic.monthly_cash_txn_count: Average number of cash-based transactions per month
dynamic.monthly_weekday_txn_pct: Percentage of transactions performed on weekdays
dynamic.monthly_weekend_txn_pct: Percentage of transactions performed on weekends
